text.name: Warlord’s Banner — Vitality
text.description:
{Warlord’s Banner — Vitality}

Adds 2 health, then +10% total health (native rounding). One worn item per troop.

text.name: Warlord’s Banner — Attack
text.description:
{Warlord’s Banner — Attack}

Adds 2 Attack, then +10% total Attack (native rounding). One worn item per troop.

text.name: Warlord’s Banner — Defense
text.description:
{Warlord’s Banner — Defense}

Adds 2 Defense, then +10% total Defense (native rounding). One worn item per troop.

text.name: Warlord’s Banner — Damage
text.description:
{Warlord’s Banner — Damage}

Adds 1 base damage, then +10% total damage (native rounding). One worn item per troop.

text.name: Warlord’s Banner — Speed
text.description:
{Warlord’s Banner — Speed}

Adds 1 Speed, then +10% total Speed (native rounding). One worn item per troop.

text.name: Warlord’s Banner — Experience
text.description:
{Warlord’s Banner — Experience}

Adds 50% to the native stack experience gain modifier. One worn item per troop.

text.name: Warlord’s Banner — Armor piercing
text.description:
{Warlord’s Banner — Armor piercing}

Ignores 25% of the target’s Defense when attacking. One worn item per troop.

text.name: Warlord’s Banner — Melee protection
text.description:
{Warlord’s Banner — Melee protection}

Reduces incoming physical melee damage by 25%. One worn item per troop.

text.name: Warlord’s Banner — Retaliation
text.description:
{Warlord’s Banner — Retaliation}

Allows 2 additional retaliations per round. One worn item per troop.
